column2: Turns traction control off. Ride gently on wet or loose ground until you know how it behaves.

column2: Below 3 km/h, the motor can pull from a standstill as soon as you use the throttle.
column3: Por debajo de 3 km/h, el motor puede arrancar desde parado en cuanto uses el acelerador.
column4: Below 3 km/h, the motor can start from a standstill as soon as you use the throttle.

column2: Turns motor braking off, so your brakes do more of the stopping.
column3: Se desactivará la recuperación de energía, que frena con el motor, así que tus frenos tendrán que trabajar más para detenerte.
column4: The energy recovery, which brakes with the motor, will be disabled, so your brakes will have to work harder to stop you.
